description: Presidential Secretariat - Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979
categorisation: This gazette content involves the declaration of certain services as essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It constitutes a legal/regulatory action by the President exercising statutory powers to modify the legal framework governing public services. The content focuses on establishing regulatory requirements and compliance obligations rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
